name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation recognizing Healthy Day Partners, Encinitas Union School District and The Ecology Center for their Farm to School Efforts including the Healthy School Lunch Program, Farm Lab and DREAMS Campus
4B.
Proclamation for Clean Air Day in Encinitas
4C.
Recognition of Alliance Green Builders for the completion of four certified GOLD GreenPoint Rated homes registered in the City’s Green Building Incentive Program
4D.
Presentation by Director of Public Works Quiram regarding Public Works Wastewater Division Sewer System Management Plan
4E.
Presentation by San Diego City Attorney Mara Elliott regarding the City of San Diego’s Safe Storage of Firearms Ordinance
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the September 11, 2019 Regular Meeting and September 13, 2019 Special-Closed Session Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-09-25 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-09-25 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-17 establishing vehicle length and width limits on South Coast Highway 101 (adjacent to Cardiff State Beach), Moonlight Beach, Swami’s Beach, Grandview Beach, and Beacon’s Beach Parking Lots. Contact Persons: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Arts Director Campbell and Development Services Director Wisneski
Adopt Ordinance No. 2019-17 titled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Vehicle Length and Width Limits on South Coast Highway 101 (adjacent to Cardiff State Beach), Moonlight Beach, Swami’s Beach, Grandview Beach, and Beacon’s Beach Parking Lots Between Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day.”
2019-09-25 Item 08C Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-17
8D.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-20 Adding Chapter 9.31 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Safe Storage of Firearms. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance 2019-20 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Chapter 9.31 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Safe Storage of Firearms.”
2019-09-25 Item 08D Safe Storage of Firearms Ordinance
8E.
Notice of Completion for the Park Shade Structure Design and Installation BID-PR-18-04. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2019-09-25 Item 08E Notice of Completion for the Park Shade Structure Design and Installation
8F.
Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the Construction of the El Camino Real Mobility and Striping Improvements (CS20B). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the El Camino Real Signing and Striping Project.
2019-09-25 Item 08F Agreement With OMWD for the Construction of the El Camino Real Mobility and Striping Improvements
8G.
Memorandum of understanding between the City of Encinitas, the Encinitas Preservation Association, and Encinitas 101 Main Street Association for a community special event to celebrate the historic designation of the Encinitas Boathouses. Contact Person: Management Analyst Brencick
Approve a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas, the Encinitas Preservation Association, and Encinitas 101 Main Street Association.
2019-09-25 Item 08G MOU Regarding Boathouses
8H.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the North San Diego Small Business Development Center (SBDC). Contact Person: Management Analyst Brencick
Approve the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the North San Diego Small Business Development Center hosted by MiraCosta College.
2019-09-25 Item 08H MOU Regarding Small Business Development Center
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8F.
Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the Construction of the El Camino Real Mobility and Striping Improvements (CS20B). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the El Camino Real Signing and Striping Project.
8F.
Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the Construction of the El Camino Real Mobility and Striping Improvements (CS20B). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Agreement with Olivenhain Municipal Water District (OMWD) for the El Camino Real Signing and Striping Project.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider Resolution No. 2019-71 and introduce City Council Ordinance No.2019-13, which propose changes of zoning classifications with an associated boundary adjustment, for the Valley parcel from Rural Residential 2 (RR-2) to Rural Residential 1 (RR-1) and Rural Residential (RRFP), and for a portion of the Kratzer parcel from Rural Residential (RRFP) to Rural Residential 1 (RR-1) for portions of the subject parcels. The proposed ordinance and resolution will amend the City's Zoning Map, General Plan, and Local Coastal Program. CASE NO.: 18-047 ZA/GPA/LCPA/BA; LOCATION: 2423 5th Street (Valley) & 2425 5th Street (Kratzer). Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
The Planning Commission recommends that the City Council take the following actions: 1) Approve Resolution No. 2019-71 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, approving amendments to the General Plan and Local Coastal Program;" and 2) Introduce Ordinance No. 2019-13 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to the Zoning Map of the City of Encinitas to reflect changes made with the approval of Case No. 18-047 GPA/ZA/LCPA/BA."
2019-09-25 Item 10A General Plan Amendment for 5th Street
10B.
South Coast Highway 101 Mobility Enhancements Project (CS20E). Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Approve the striping plan and slurry seal for the mobility enhancements on South Coast Highway 101 between Chesterfield Drive and City of Solana Beach for a total project cost of $500,000; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-81, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.”
2019-09-25 Item 10B South Coast Highway 101 Striping
10C.
Approval of the Agreement between City of Encinitas and Devaney Pate Morris & Cameron for Interim City Attorney services designating Leslie Devaney as Interim City Attorney.
Approve the Professional Services Agreement for Interim City Attorney services between the City and Devaney Pate Morris & Cameron designating Leslie Devaney as interim City Attorney effective September 27, 2019.
2019-09-25 Item 10C Interim City Attorney Agreement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Member Initiated Item from Council Member Mosca updating the City Council on the progress of the Rancho Santa Fe Road Task Force (“Task Force”) and requesting additional work to be performed by city staff to further explore and develop the options available to the community for addressing traffic congestion along Rancho Santa Fe Road (“RSF”) during the morning and the afternoon peak traffic periods.
2019-09-25 Item 12A Council Initiated Item from Council Member Mosca
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 23, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
